notes: Official audit-report archive obtained from the company public IR board (bcode101), which links the company-owned CDN PDFs. No aggregator values used. Source files are consolidated, not separate company accounts.
2007–2009 figures are Korean won thousands scaled by1000;2010onward figures are won millions scaled by1000000. Per-share values remain won.

K-IFRS adopted2011with2010comparative;2007–2009 K-GAAP. Historical net income is attributable to equity holders/owners, not group total profit. Parent equity populated only where a direct subtotal is printed; no subtraction of minority interests.
Capex is the direct cash flow PP&E acquisition line, negative, excluding separately reported intangibles. No total debt derived by summing current/noncurrent borrowings or leases.
Each odd-year audit supplies current and prior-year comparative. restated remains false unless an explicit restatement was identified; next-year comparative alone is not a restatement.
No direct closing share count, annual dividend-per-share or consolidated headcount was extracted from these statements; fields remain null.
